businessProblem: A specialty bakery's gross margin has fallen for four straight quarters while flour and labor costs climb; the owner wants the real driver before touching prices.

evidence.finding: Gross margin declined from 44% to 30% across four consecutive quarters
Per-unit ingredient and labor cost rose 19% year over year on core products
Production throughput and waste rates held steady; no capacity constraint observed
Competitor retail prices roughly stable; no significant share movement reported
